caption: The drawing depicts a single clear glass decanter with a stopper, rendered in grayscale pencil or ink. The decanter has a bulbous lower body with elongated, vertical oval facets or panels encircling its surface, which taper upward into a slender neck. The neck is topped with a broad, flat rim that supports a stopper. The stopper has a textured, elongated, conical shape resembling a pinecone or an artichoke, distinguished by a diamond-pattern etching. The entire object is centered on a plain background within a rectangular border, and the artist's signature, "Erwin Schwabe," appears in the lower right corner of the border.
title: Glass Wine Decanter
